body.condition: The conditional law of \(Y\mid A=0,X=x\) has Lebesgue density \(\eta_0^{\mathrm{w}}(y\mid x)=1\) for every \((y,x)\in\mathcal Y\times\mathcal X\).

novel.justification: This condition defines only a nonempty lower-bound witness subfamily, not ambient model regularity. It is realized whenever the control outcome is independent of the covariates and uniform on the compact outcome cube, while the treated conditional density and propensity vary freely subject to the ambient conditions. It neither links arm \(0\) to arm \(1\) nor narrows the upper-bound model.
